provenance_of_the_table: ecdata allcurves/alllabels extraction and exact integer discriminant factor valuations
arithmetic: exact integers throughout; no floating point
why_check_4_is_vacuous_here: this table is the census's BASE curves — one representative per isogeny class, every label ending in 1 — so no class holds two curves and none could have disagreed. Zero split classes is therefore not evidence that rank is constant on a class; it is the shape of the table. Testing doc 01 §6 needs a table carrying the whole class.
what_check_4_tests: Phase 0 doc 01 §6 asserts rank is constant across an isogeny class. Cremona labels carry the class, so this is measured on every class present rather than assumed.
one_direction_only: check 3 tests that every conductor prime divides the discriminant, which is a theorem. The converse is false — a prime can divide Δ with good reduction after a change of model — so it is not checked and its absence is not a gap.
